To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
T-PLL is a disease in which genomic integrity is impaired, as evidenced by frequent mutations in the ataxia-telangiectasia gene ATM, and that the DNA mismatch repair system is not defective in T-PLL.

(a) T-PLL is a chronic mature neoplasia of T cells; (b) T-PLL has multiple cytogenetic abnormalities, including trisomy 14 and deletions of the long arm of chromosome 8, and is characterized by a high incidence of ATM mutations; (c) the BAT-25 and -26 markers, which are unstable in mismatch repair-defective cells, are stable in T-PLL.
the BAT-25 and 26 markers are not mutated in T-PLL.
